Name: Quantitative Trader/Researcher Internship
Company Description: Jane Street is a global proprietary trading firm and liquidity provider known for its expertise in quantitative trading, technology development, and financial engineering. Headquartered in New York with offices in London, Hong Kong, and Amsterdam, the firm trades a wide array of asset classes—including equities, ETFs, options, fixed income, and crypto—across both traditional and electronic markets. Jane Street combines rigorous mathematical research with cutting-edge software development, operating in a highly collaborative, flat organisational structure. It is a major player in ETF market making and provides liquidity to markets around the clock, contributing to efficiency and price discovery. The firm is known for its analytical culture, competitive hiring process, and deep investment in proprietary systems and infrastructure. Jane Street remains privately held and low-profile, but plays an outsized role in global financial markets, particularly in electronic and algorithmic trading.

Name: Intern, Business Relationship Management - ESG
Company Description: Fitch Ratings is one of the world’s leading credit rating agencies, providing risk assessments for sovereigns, corporates, financial institutions, structured finance products, and infrastructure projects. Headquartered in New York and London, it is part of Fitch Group, a subsidiary of Hearst. Fitch plays a critical role in global capital markets by helping investors evaluate the creditworthiness of issuers and debt instruments. Its ratings and research are widely used in risk models, regulatory frameworks, and fixed income strategies. The agency is known for its methodical approach to credit analysis and for providing more flexible rating frameworks compared to its larger peers. It also invests heavily in analytics platforms and ESG scoring, aiming to increase transparency and broaden investor tools in an evolving financial landscape.

Name: 2027 Transaction Finance Off cycle Intern (January to June)
Company Description: Blackstone is one of the world’s leading investment firms, specialising in private equity, real estate, credit, and infrastructure. Founded in 1985 and based in New York, the firm manages capital on behalf of pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and individual investors. Blackstone is known for its scale, global reach, and ability to take large, complex positions across industries. It combines deep operational support with financial engineering and has a track record of building value in both private and public market investments.

Name: Student Analyst, Brookfield Private Wealth
Company Description: Brookfield is a global alternative asset manager with expertise in real estate, infrastructure, renewable power, private equity, and credit. Headquartered in Toronto, the firm manages over $900 billion in assets and operates across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Brookfield takes a value-oriented, long-term approach, often investing in physical and operationally intensive assets. It is also a leading investor in decarbonisation and transition infrastructure through its Brookfield Renewable and Brookfield Asset Management divisions.

Name: Corporate Access, Off-cycle Internship (6-months)
Company Description: Point72 is a global asset management firm founded by Steven A. Cohen in 2014, following the transition from SAC Capital. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the firm manages capital across multiple strategies including long/short equity, macro, systematic, and private investments. Its discretionary investing teams operate with autonomy within a multi-manager platform, while its Cubist division focuses on quantitative and algorithmic trading. Point72 also runs a venture capital arm, Point72 Ventures, investing in fintech, healthcare, and enterprise technology. With offices in major financial centres including New York, London, Tokyo, and Singapore, the firm is known for its strong emphasis on data, technology, and talent development, particularly through its structured analyst training programs like the Point72 Academy.

Name: 2027 January Off-Cycle Analyst (Strategic Advisory & Restructuring)
Company Description: PJT Partners is a global advisory-focused investment bank, formed as a spin-off from Blackstone in 2015. Headquartered in New York, the firm provides strategic advisory services in M&A, restructuring, and capital markets to corporates, governments, and institutional investors. It is particularly known for its strong presence in complex financial restructurings and special situations, having advised on many of the largest corporate bankruptcies and recapitalisations globally. PJT also operates a capital raising platform, Park Hill, which advises alternative asset managers on fundraising and secondary transactions. With a senior-led, conflict-free model, PJT competes with larger banks by offering high-touch, independent advice in critical, high-stakes mandates.

Name: Campus Quantitative Research Intern (Off-Cycle - Winter/Spring 2027)
Company Description: Jump Trading is a proprietary trading firm and technology company based in Chicago, known for its expertise in algorithmic and high-frequency trading across global financial markets. Founded in 1999, the firm trades a broad range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, futures, options, and cryptocurrencies, operating on over 100 exchanges worldwide. Jump places a strong emphasis on quantitative research, advanced hardware and software development, and low-latency infrastructure, competing with firms such as DRW, Citadel Securities, and Jane Street. It is also involved in crypto through Jump Crypto, a dedicated division focused on trading, venture investments, and protocol development. The firm is privately held and secretive, known for its flat structure, highly selective hiring, and deep investment in proprietary technology and applied science.

Name: Off-Cycle Intern, Financial and Valuation Advisory (Hong Kong)
Company Description: Houlihan Lokey is a global investment bank headquartered in Los Angeles, specialising in M&A advisory, capital markets, financial restructuring, and valuation services. The firm is widely recognised for its leading role in middle-market transactions and has consistently ranked as the top global M&A advisor by volume. In restructuring, Houlihan Lokey is a dominant player, often advising both creditors and debtors on high-profile bankruptcies and distressed situations. It also has one of the largest dedicated financial valuation teams globally, supporting litigation, tax, and financial reporting mandates. With offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves public and private companies, financial sponsors, and government entities. Houlihan Lokey’s sector coverage spans consumer, healthcare, tech, energy, and industrials, and it is particularly known for its rigorous analytics, high-touch advisory model, and long-term client relationships.

Name: Quantitative Analytics Associate Off Cycle Internship 2027
Company Description: Barclays is a British multinational bank offering retail, corporate, and investment banking services across the UK and globally. With roots dating back to 1690, it has played a central role in the evolution of modern banking. Headquartered in London, the firm is a major player in global capital markets, advising on M&A, underwriting debt and equity, and providing financing solutions. Its retail and commercial divisions serve millions of customers, while its investment bank operates across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East.

Name: Deals - HK Winter Intern
Company Description: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers) is one of the world’s largest professional services networks, providing audit, tax, consulting, and deals advisory services to clients across sectors. Operating in over 150 countries, the firm works with multinational corporations, governments, and private enterprises on matters ranging from digital transformation and regulatory compliance to mergers, restructuring, and sustainability strategy. PwC’s UK member firm is a major employer of graduates and professionals across audit, consulting, and technology functions, while its global network is structured to combine local market expertise with international reach. The firm also invests heavily in upskilling, ESG advisory, and automation, positioning itself at the forefront of industry change.

Name: Quantitative Research Intern
Company Description: Engineers Gate is a quantitative investment management firm that utilizes mathematical models and data science to drive its trading strategies. Founded in 2014 and based in New York, the firm focuses on systematic research and technology to identify opportunities across diverse global financial markets. It attracts talent from the fields of engineering, physics, and computer science to build robust automated systems. The firm emphasizes a collaborative approach to quantitative finance while maintaining a disciplined focus on risk management and consistent capital growth.

Name: Intern - Rates Relative Value
Company Description: ExodusPoint Capital Management is a multi-strategy hedge fund based in New York, founded in 2017 by former executives from Millennium Management. The firm manages capital across a wide range of strategies including equities, credit, macro, and quantitative investing, operating with a multi-manager, platform-style model. It has quickly grown into one of the largest hedge fund launches in history, with billions in assets under management and a global footprint spanning North America, Europe, and Asia. ExodusPoint is structured around independent portfolio managers who operate semi-autonomously, supported by a centralised infrastructure covering technology, compliance, and risk. The firm is known for its selective recruitment of top-tier investment talent and its focus on leveraging technology and data science to enhance execution and research. It competes at the highest level of the hedge fund industry, alongside firms like Citadel, Point72, and Millennium.

Name: M&A Analyst Internship
Company Description: BDA Partners is an international investment banking advisory firm focused on cross-border transactions involving Asia. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in North America, Europe, and across Asia, BDA advises clients on mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and capital raising. The firm works with multinationals, private equity funds, and family-owned businesses, often facilitating inbound and outbound deals between Asia and the rest of the world. Its strength lies in mid-market transactions, sector expertise, and regional connectivity.

Name: Actuarial Internship 2027
Company Description: Sun Life is a leading international financial services organization providing asset management, wealth, insurance, and health solutions. Founded in 1865 and headquartered in Toronto, the company serves millions of clients across Canada, the United States, Asia, and other global markets. It operates through a diverse portfolio of businesses focused on helping individuals achieve lifetime financial security and assisting companies in advancing the health and productivity of their employees. Sun Life is recognized for its long history of stability and its strategic focus on sustainable growth and digital innovation within the financial services sector.

Name: 2027 | Global Investment Research, Consumer | Seasonal / Off-cycle Internship
Company Description: Goldman Sachs is one of the world’s most prestigious investment banks and financial institutions, offering a wide range of services in investment banking, asset management, global markets, consumer banking, and wealth management. Founded in 1869 and headquartered in New York, the firm serves corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals globally. Goldman is widely regarded for its M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, and institutional trading, and has been involved in many of the largest and most complex financial transactions in history. It also operates Marcus, its consumer banking platform, and has expanded into transaction banking and alternative investments. Known for its elite talent, risk culture, and thought leadership, Goldman Sachs is also increasingly focused on sustainability, digital finance, and private capital markets. It plays a key role in shaping financial innovation and global capital flows.

Name: Global Markets Off-cycle Intern (Jan to Apr 2027)
Company Description: Crédit Agricole is one of the largest banking groups in Europe and a major player in retail, corporate, and investment banking. Headquartered in France, the group includes a network of regional cooperative banks as well as specialised subsidiaries offering services in asset management, insurance, leasing, and private banking. Crédit Agricole is a leader in green finance and responsible investing, and it supports clients across Europe and internationally with a strong presence in agriculture, infrastructure, and export financing.

Name: Intern (Financial Institutions Department)
Company Description: CMB Wing Lung Bank is a Hong Kong based financial institution that provides a comprehensive range of banking services including retail banking, corporate banking, and wealth management. Founded in 1933 and acquired by China Merchants Bank in 2008, it serves as the overseas platform for its parent company to expand international operations. The bank focuses on cross border financial services and connects the capital markets of mainland China with the rest of the world. It maintains a strong presence in the Pearl River Delta region and is recognized for its stable heritage and commitment to high quality customer service.

Name: Quantitative Researcher Intern
Company Description: Y-intercept is a specialized financial technology company that provides a data infrastructure platform for businesses to manage and analyze complex transaction information. Founded to simplify the integration of financial data, the firm offers tools that allow organizations to map, normalize, and consume payment and ledger data more efficiently. Y-intercept serves clients across the fintech and commerce sectors by focusing on scalability and the reduction of technical debt. It operates by streamlining the connection between disparate data sources and internal business systems to improve operational decision making.

Name: Wealth Management - Project Intern - Operation
Company Description: China International Capital Corporation (CICC) is a leading Chinese investment bank offering services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset management, and private equity. Founded in 1995 as China’s first joint venture investment bank, CICC is headquartered in Beijing and operates globally through offices in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The firm plays a key role in China’s capital markets and serves both domestic and international clients, often advising on major IPOs, M&A, and financing deals.

Name: Actuarial Internship (Full-time for 2027 H1/H2)
Company Description: FWD Group is a pan-Asian life insurance company with a focus on making the insurance journey simpler, faster, and smoother. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Hong Kong, the company operates across ten markets in Asia, including mainland China, Southeast Asia, and Japan. FWD leverages digital technology and human-centric design to provide products such as life, medical, critical illness, and employee benefits insurance. The firm aims to change the way people feel about insurance by using a customer-led approach and accessible platforms to reach a growing demographic of digitally savvy consumers.

Name: Student Internship Programme 1H2027
Company Description: Hang Seng Bank is a prominent financial institution based in Hong Kong, offering a comprehensive range of retail banking, wealth management, and corporate banking services. Founded in 1933, it operates as a principal subsidiary of the HSBC Group and maintains a significant presence across Greater China. The bank is recognized for its strong local market expertise, extensive branch network, and digital banking capabilities. It focuses on serving individual customers and small to medium sized enterprises while providing institutional clients with sophisticated financial solutions.

Name: Finance Intern (6 months)
Company Description: Gobi Partners is a pan Asian venture capital firm that focuses on early stage and growth investments across Southeast Asia, North Asia, and the Greater Bay Area. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and Hong Kong, the firm manages assets on behalf of institutional investors and family offices. Gobi Partners is recognized for its commitment to identifying emerging market opportunities and fostering regional tech ecosystems. It combines strategic mentorship with capital support to help startups scale across fragmented markets while navigating diverse regulatory and cultural landscapes.
